'''Baron Longshore''' is the captain of the ''[[Heedless]]'', a ship in the pirate fleet of the [[Southsea Freebooters]], and hails from [[Gilneas (kingdom)|Gilneas]].<ref name="wanted">{{Neutral}} [16] [[WANTED: Baron Longshore]]</ref> He is located on the [[Merchant Coast]] in the [[Barrens]].

[[Gazlowe]] has put a prize on Baron Longshore's head on charges of piracy and for leading vessels of the Southsea Freebooters.<ref name="wanted"/>

==Objective of==
* Drops [[Baron Longshore's Head]] for {{Neutral}} [16] [[WANTED: Baron Longshore]].
